CustomField.description: Namespaced stable ID of the remote record, e.g. jira:10023. Uniqueness in Salesforce is per-field, not per-system, so the system prefix is what keeps a Jira issue ID from colliding with an Asana GID. All upserts key off this field. Not required: unique fields permit multiple nulls, so records can still be created by hand.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Namespaced remote ID, e.g. jira:10023. Never the issue key - keys change when a project is renamed or an issue is moved.
CustomField.label: External Id
